name: sprite-sheet-kit
description: Pack 2–16 actual JPEG/PNG/WebP sprites into a transparent PNG atlas and named JSON frame map. Choose 1–8 columns and 0–16 pixels of transparent padding. Original dimensions are retained with centered grid placement after orientation and sRGB normalization. No resizing, trimming, rotation, edge extrusion or animation timing is added. Each source is bounded to 1024 pixels per side; combined source and atlas are limited to 16 megapixels, atlas sides to 4096 pixels, and combined download to 32 MB. Inspect named frames and download actual outputs. Requires a connected account; output links are public.
